name: wikijs-mcp
description: Manage a Wiki.js 2.x instance from Claude — read, search, create, update, and delete pages, plus assets.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch a page's full content by ID.

tools.name: upload_asset
tools.description: Upload a file to the asset library.

wikijs_url.title: Wiki.js URL
wikijs_url.description: Base URL of your Wiki.js instance, no trailing slash (e.g. https://wiki.example.com).

wikijs_api_token.title: API Token
wikijs_api_token.description: Wiki.js API token (Administration -> API Access) with read/write permissions.
